### F-277 — The CLI demo test promised a clean stderr, which a loaded runner cannot keep

> _2026-09-26 · demo/blong-cli · resolved_

The assertion `and nothing was logged to stderr` failed in CI twice, and the fix chosen first —
passing `--log.slowMs=60000` to the spawned command — was a no-op: a CLI built on `runCli` loads its
suite with `load(suite, name, name, intents)` and drops every flag that is not part of the command,
so the margin never reached the config. Raising the margin would not have been enough either: the
registry's port steps and the knex adapter's schema sync call `withProgress` without one (T-154), so
no single value covers the framework's own steps. What the assertion is about is the command's
contract — the result is the only thing on stdout, and nothing the command writes reaches stderr —
so the test now filters the framework's log lines (a timestamped level line plus its payload
indented two spaces under it, or the shorter form the log's own bootstrap uses) and asserts that
what remains is empty. Verified by forcing the framework's margin to 1ms, which put fourteen warning
lines on stderr while the assertion still passed.

Corrected: the flag route was a no-op; the assertion now tolerates the framework's own log lines.
